limit.unit: free runs > 10 mm in one layer
limit.evidence: OBRTAJ terrace-1 layer 0: 203 runs, 6.9 m free thread in ONE layer, 36 % of the whole object free — held flat. KRAK K1 layer 0: 33 runs, 1.25 m — destroyed. The quantity of hanging thread does NOT decide; S2 reports, S3 refuses

S3.question: how far a free tip reaches, and whether it is ever tied

median.unit: mm, median free reach (to solid material) of the loose tips of one layer
median.evidence: OBRTAJ: 66 terrace layers, medians 6–17.6, held flat; PRAG (2026-09-25, BOTH machines, terrace printed LAST): median 20.7, held — the band 17.6–20.7 is now printed record, and the ORDER rule is part of the evidence; KRAK K1: twelve layers at 22.6–24.5, destroyed on both machines; RAZMAK terrace-1: 30.7, nested and stopped. Beyond free tips: VEZ_ENDER_X2 (2026-09-27, pre-tied-closed-corbel/v1) completed reaches 24/30/36 by tying every old frontier — tips that a later pass ties are S4 business, not S3; the free-tip ceiling stays 20.7

max.unit: mm, longest free reach in one layer (reported, not refused: KRAK failed at 24.6, far below the OBRTAJ maximum — the longest tip alone does not decide)
max.evidence: OBRTAJ terrace-1 max 37.6 held; RAZMAK terrace-1 max 73.8 nested

min.unit: mm, shortest tip of a layer that has long tips (reported, not refused: the median alone separates the printed record, and a bracket built on one comparison must not refuse)
min.evidence: OBRTAJ every terrace min 2.0–3.4 held (short tips among long ones); RAZMAK terrace-1 min 12.4 nested; KRAK K1 min 21.7 destroyed

S4.question: does extrusion pass over a tip that is still loose

limit.unit: mm of Z between a still-loose tip and extrusion passing over it
limit.evidence: KRAK: K2 castle legs pass 5.3–8.6 mm above K1 tips that nothing ever tied, K3 over K2 likewise — destroyed. OBRTAJ: zero such passes (its steps go inward, nothing flies over a fringe) — held. Refused at any clearance ≤ 12 mm: the margin above the evidenced failure is ASSUMED

S5.question: what holds the object against what is built above it

limit.unit: mm² of first-layer contact per (mm height × mm lever)
limit.evidence: OBRTAJ 0.343 held on the Ender plate; KRAK A2L 0.352 held on the A2L plate while the object broke above it; KRAK Ender left the plate at its value — a plate number is per machine and per plate state; reported, refused only when given --s5fail

S7.question: is a layer that carries the object laid on points

limit.unit: fraction of a layer laid on material, layers with ≥ 20 layers above
limit.evidence: OBRTAJ terrace-1 layer 0: 11.8 % carried with 939 layers above — held. The fraction alone cannot refuse; reported so the joint the drag will find is known

S8.question: does every layer cross the one below

limit.unit: fraction of a layer within a quarter bead of the layer below
limit.evidence: OBRTAJ foundation and crown layers at 0.976–0.983 printed; the weave rule (Semir, 2026-09-18: every layer must cross the one below) is a GENERATOR rule — here it is reported per layer, not refused

S8.note: A-B-A-B (layer k = layer k+2) is reported, not refused: OBRTAJ printed flat with 114 such layers
